hoy.titular: Five days from Montevideo, the Pincha return to work in City Bell today

foto.alt: Estudiantes' coaching staff talk during a training session in City Bell.

hoy.resumen: After Sunday off, the squad resume training in City Bell today and travel to Montevideo on Wednesday. Saturday's final is worth US$25 million to the winners, against a Palmeiras squad valued at four times as much.

siete.titulo: The final is worth US$25 million
siete.texto: The Copa Libertadores winners take home US$25 million in CONMEBOL prize money. On the other side, according to Ámbito, stands a squad worth four times as much as the Pincha's.

siete.titulo: Palmeiras get Murilo and Piquerez back
siete.texto: According to Gazeta Esportiva and Nosso Palestra, Murilo and Piquerez are available again (they were on the bench against Flamengo); Paulinho is still with the medical department. On Tuesday 24th at 6pm in Chapecó, Abel is expected to field reserves against Chapecoense, and on Wednesday the Verdão travel to Montevideo.

siete.titulo: Copa Sudamericana 2027 secured, with the Recopa up for grabs
siete.texto: With Boca's Copa Sudamericana title, Estudiantes already have a place in the Copa Sudamericana 2027. If they win the final in Montevideo, next year they play the Copa Libertadores and also the Recopa Sudamericana against Boca.

siete.titulo: CONMEBOL puts Tiago Palacios in the spotlight
siete.texto: Six days before the final, the official Copa Libertadores account dedicated a post to Tiago Palacios, one of the Pincha's standout players in the competition, in the red-and-white shirt with the UNO as the backdrop.

siete.titulo: The road map to the Centenario
siete.texto: Monday and Tuesday, training at 9.30am in City Bell; on Wednesday 25th they train at 10am and travel to Montevideo in the afternoon (staying at the Hilton). Thursday and Friday at Montevideo City Torque's training ground, with a press conference on Friday.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar, the replacement will be decided on Tuesday
siete.texto: Baltasar Rodríguez, sent off against Flamengo, misses the final. According to Diario Hoy, Medina will choose on Tuesday between Fabricio Pérez and Monsalve to replace him, while Tobio Burgos and Tomás Palacios battle for the left side.

siete.titulo: Around 35,000 Pincha fans head for Montevideo
siete.texto: 120 coaches are going: 60 laid on by the club, leaving the UNO on the afternoon of Friday 27th, and 60 from supporters' groups and branches. Friday and Saturday ferries are sold out, and 2009 champions invited by the club will also be at the Centenario.

linea.texto: Palmeiras: reserves against Chapecoense on Tuesday and travel to Montevideo on Wednesday.
The Pincha begin final week in City Bell.
Ámbito: the Pincha play for US$25 million against a Palmeiras worth four times as much.
Medina's schedule for the week: training, travel and the Baltasar question.
CONMEBOL spotlighted Tiago Palacios six days before the final.
A day off, back to City Bell on Monday and the trip to Montevideo: the Pincha's final week.
Abel Ferreira looks ahead to the final: "Our team will fight to be champions".
The Pincha could play the Recopa de Campeones in La Plata to start 2027.
Medina in an interview with CONMEBOL: the team's emotion and his confidence for the final.
From Bilardo to Medina: the five managers Sosa has had at Estudiantes.
With a goal from Ascacíbar, Boca won the Copa Sudamericana and put the Pincha into the 2027 edition.
Palmeiras drew 1-1 with Flamengo, who are crowned Brasileirão champions.
"Close your eyes and believe": the poster campaign building up to the final on the streets.
Medina looks ahead to the final: "When our emotions are running high, we usually play well".
